reasons.plausibility: It aligns with established high-entropy alloy principles that near-equiatomic compositions can suppress phase segregation and reduce diffusion, though the exact extent of sluggish diffusion remains debated.
reasons.testability: The proposed controlled composition variations and subsequent high-temperature exposure to assess structural changes provide a direct, well-defined experiment to confirm or refute the role of configurational entropy in stability.
reasons.usefulness: It offers a clear and targeted approach to empirically distinguish between hypotheses, guiding fabrication strategies for stable, near-equiatomic multi-element nanoparticles under high-temperature service conditions.
